From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Transit & venue-handoff playbook for TruNorth workshop

Team / Sara —

Attached is version 1 of the staging manifest and the proposed shipping label set for the TruNorth onsite on Oct 23–24. High-level notes:

- Pickup window: Oct 22, 20:00–22:00 (BlueLine Logistics pickup). Items: 2 demo racks (CRATE-DRK-01/02), 3 flight cases with peripherals, 120 swag boxes, and 350 printed handbooks.
- Insured value: $28,500 (declared on airway bill).
- Preferred carrier: BlueLine (white-glove, liftgate). Secondary carrier: RapidParcel if BlueLine capacity constrained.
- Venue acceptance window: Oct 23, 08:00–11:00 (please confirm exact receiving dock).
- Onsite staging: A/V check at 13:00 on Oct 23 (Jordan to confirm AV headcount).
- Last-mile special instructions: driver to call Michael (venue contact) 30 min prior to arrival. Delivery must be signed by on-site facilities or TruNorth rep.

Action items I want to lock down this week:
1) Jordan — confirm BlueLine booking and provide driver ETA + COI.
2) Neha — confirm whether we should add pallet-level tamper seals and add a second manifest copy inside each case.
3) Sara — please confirm venue receiving dock number and whether an escort is required after delivery.

Attachments: staging_manifest_v1.xlsx; shipping_labels_10-22.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@trunorth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transit & venue-handoff playbook for TruNorth workshop

Thanks Ben — good start. A couple points from the Redwood side: 

- Please treat the demo racks as lane-1 priority. If BlueLine has to split the load, keep rack CRATE-DRK-01 on the first truck. That rack contains customer-specific dataset droplets; we can't risk an overnight layover.
- Yes to pallet tamper seals. Jordan — order 6 seals and include one duplicate manifest inside each flight case (PDF + paper).
- Insurance: finance asked we also send a shortproof of transit coverage to TruNorth procurement prior to pickup (I'll draft email).
- Vendor staffing: plan for two Redwood techs on-site for setup (Ben — are you available 10/23 midday?).

Jordan — please add BlueLine contact name and COI into the manifest and mark any crates with battery/Li-ion signage if applicable.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0228

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@trunorth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transit & venue-handoff playbook for TruNorth workshop

Quick update after call with BlueLine and the venue. See inline changes and updated manifest attached (updated_manifest_v2.xlsx).

- BlueLine lead: Victor Ramos, dispatcher +1 323-555-4482. Pickup confirmed Oct 22 at 20:30. Truck: 26' box with liftgate, white-glove option added. COI expires 11/01/2026, I'll attach the PDF to the HubSpot deal.
- Venue contact: Michael Torres (Grand Harbor Conference Center), receiving dock #4. Phone +1 206-555-1010. Michael requested that drivers use door code 4412 and call the facilities desk on arrival; he said an escort will be assigned.
- Customs: N/A (domestic). Batteries: one flight case contains two demo batteries; they are UN3481-compliant and will be labeled.
- Driver ETA window to venue on Oct 23: 08:30–09:15. Tentative A/V check is still 13:00; recommend we push to 12:30 if setup crew is on-site earlier.

Action items now:
- Ben: confirm which two Redwood techs are traveling and provide their cell numbers.
- Neha: send the shortproof insurance note to Sara / procurement.
- Sara: please confirm that TruNorth facilities can sign for the shipment; if they cannot, we'll arrange an on-site Redwood staff member to accept.

Attachments: updated_manifest_v2.xlsx

---
Jordan Blake
Event Logistics Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@trunorth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 17:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Transit & venue-handoff playbook for TruNorth workshop

Thanks — this is very thorough and appreciated. A few confirmations from TruNorth facilities: 

- Receiving dock #4 works and facilities will assign an escort. Please have the driver call Michael Torres at arrival (he's copied above in our contact list).
- We can sign for the shipment; please include a digital manifest emailed to facilities at facilities@grandharborvenue.com at least 2 hours before arrival.
- Door code 4412 is correct; however, security requires all non-TruNorth staff to be on the visitor list. Ben — please send the two techs' full names and driver license last names so security can pre-clear them.
- Please label the pallet with the workshop name and contact number: "Redwood Onsite — TruNorth Exec Day — +1 415-555-0132".

We'll have a small storage closet available for crates that arrive early (no overnight storage guarantee beyond the workshop dates). If anything changes on our end (e.g., earlier acceptance or space issues), I'll notify you immediately.

Sara Liu
Program Manager, TruNorth Capital
sara.liu@trunorth.com | +1 212-555-0786
